findings.title: A scientific child survives its worker's death and keeps computing after the job is marked interrupted
findings.minimal_input: hero-v2 baseline on main 9cc90e0; scientific child held inside the adapter by the harness barrier (after setsid and limits); SIGKILL the worker process group
findings.command: python3.11 evaluation/cli.py run --lane offline_real_science --subject http-launch --diagnostic science_barrier --results evaluation/results/previews/x --only RS-CANCEL-RESTART
findings.expected: no scientific computation outlives its job: the child detects parent death and ends its session, or recovery kills sessions recorded at dispatch
findings.observed: child pid alive 1 s after the worker was killed and still alive after worker --recover marked the run interrupted; only the harness teardown removed it. API cancellation of a running job does kill the child (passes).

evidence.context: packages/groundwork_adapter/docs/BRIDGE.md requires the launching parent to kill the session before its own exit; a SIGKILLed parent cannot
evidence.suggested_seam: parent-death watchdog in science._child (poll os.getppid() or pipe EOF, then killpg own session), plus persisting the child pgid so worker --recover can kill leftovers

findings.title: On macOS every scientific job fails: RLIMIT_NPROC is per user, so the bounded child cannot spawn CPython 3.11
findings.minimal_input: macOS 26.7 arm64 user with 649 processes; resource policy process cap 32 (process_count: rlimit_nproc_per_user)
findings.command: .venv/bin/python -c "import os,resource,subprocess; pid=os.fork()\nif pid==0:\n resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_NPROC,(32,32)); subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/true'])"  -> BlockingIOError Errno 35; also BEAN_COUNTERDEX_PYTHON=/opt/homebrew/bin/python3.11 .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_science_boundary.py tests/test_scientific_http.py
findings.expected: the supervised child launches the prepared CPython 3.11 runtime on the team's Mac; process-tree containment comes from the owned session/process group
findings.observed: spawn fails with EAGAIN at caps 32 and 64 (passes at 4000); runs end failed with scientific_runtime_unavailable / scientific_worker_failed; 4 backend tests fail on the Mac only (Linux run passed)

evidence.suggested_seam: treat RLIMIT_NPROC on Darwin like RLIMIT_AS (report unavailable) or set it to current user process count + a small margin; keep the owned-session kill and wall clock

retests.result: Also present on Owner 2's newer branch: the plain preview's hero baseline fails the same way.

Still present on the merged main (browser-baseline integrated): RS-HERO-FULL and RS-CHANGED-INPUT fail with scientific_runtime_unavailable on this Mac without diagnostics. Owner 1 recorded an isolated reproduction on codex/science-next (bad5e9f); Owner 4's CI adds scripts/release/user_conditions_check.py for it.

Insufficient on the team's Mac: this user owns 649 processes, above 256, so spawning the engine still fails with EAGAIN (measured: caps 32 and 64 fail, 4000 succeeds). A per-user count cannot be a per-job cap.

findings.title: A design request that cites the baseline packet in source_artifact_ids cannot reach checked separation
findings.minimal_input: hero-v2 on backend/browser-baseline cc779bf: discovered pair, grid [6,8] h, allowance 1/5, horizon 8, construction+continuation, source_artifact_ids=[baseline native artifact]
findings.command: python3.11 evaluation/cli.py run --lane offline_real_science --subject http-launch --app-repo <worktree of backend/browser-baseline> --diagnostic relax_nproc --results evaluation/results/previews/x --only RS-HERO-FULL
findings.expected: the walkthrough's documented design scope (with source artifact ids) yields checked_pair_separation for a checkable pair
findings.observed: design_tier numerical_guidance, reason invalid_input; engine report.checked.error invalid_input at field ['pair']: 'Missing or unknown fields in this version' - candidates get source_artifact_digest = the baseline application packet, which the engine tries to reuse as a pair certificate. The same pair without source_artifact_ids, separately approved: checked_pair_separation, verification valid, fresh replay passed, selected 8 h with a positive exact margin

evidence.suggested_seam: do not project the baseline application packet as a pair-reuse source_artifact_digest (pass it as historical context), or teach the engine to accept baseline certificates; and return a specific reason code instead of a silent numerical fallback
